report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all sampled checkout, order, inventory, payment and Redis/Postgres spans returning 200/ok. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s, and the only deployment record is baseline v1.0.0 with no prior version. No current evidence establishes a bounded cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error/failure telemetry (non-2xx spans, error logs) confirming checkout errors actually occur
Order logs (ev-...-order-logs) excluded from context; needed to characterize any errors
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the incident window
Latency/error metrics for checkout and downstream dependencies during the incident window
